scope: Savage Strike P1 provenance enrichment and canonical integration boundary

evidence.identity: SSGSS Vegito Super Skill; current Xenoverse 2 references and the maintained research batch agree on identity.
evidence.acquisition: TP Medal Shop availability is directly corroborated by dated Xenoverse 2 community/guide sources. Exact current rotation timing is not established.
evidence.ki_cost: 100 Ki is supported by a later secondary Xenoverse 2 reference and an independent damage-test document; this is suitable for the research layer but should remain source-attributed until canonical integration.
evidence.mechanics: Forward punch and alternate teleport-above/downward-punch input are corroborated; knockback pursuit/combo-extension behavior is documented. Exact frame data and damage values remain unresolved.
evidence.price_conflict: Dated sources report 200 TP Medals for the original/rotation listing, while a later secondary guide reports 300 TP Medals. Exact current price is therefore intentionally unresolved.

repository_state.reason: Savage Strike is present in the dedicated research batch but is not currently present in the live 469-record canonical skills/index layers. No partial index-only insertion was made because that would break canonical/index parity.

next: Integrate skill-savage-strike into the canonical skills.json and skills-index.json together through the repository's supported canonical build/update path, then synchronize any acquisition/cross-domain projections that require the new canonical endpoint.
